result:
The motion layer is shipped on every screen task 11 moved, and on 15 hub windows besides. Four extras are not built, so this is only partly done. I checked the notes and git log and did no new work this run.

The shipped versions, from my notes:
- **v29.60 (`cw-uimotion`):** the shared layer, on the title and mode menu, the party demo window and the arcade attract board tab.
- **v29.62 (`cw-uimotion2`):** the pause box, the end card, the settings window and the keys window.
- **v29.82 (`cw-uimotion3`):** 15 hub windows (trader, gamble, bar, appearance, trophy, codex, leaderboard, What's New, sector, stage, carry, crate, op, welcome, terms).

The checks measure time, not pictures. They step the clock and read the animated values:
- Open at 0, 50, 100 and 200 ms.
- Stagger gaps.
- Close in under 150 ms.
- A press mid-transition, handled within one frame.
- Confirm pulse peaking at 1.06 and deny shake of 6 px or less.
- Tab slide.
- Focus ring at 33, 81 and 95 percent.
- Exactly one tick per focus change.
- The sound picker, tested through its own function because the fixture replaces `sfx()`.

I did not put these windows on the layer, on purpose: `fbmodal`, `askmodal`, `devmodal`, `cheatmodal`, `tunemodal`, `simmodal` and `sharemodal`.

Still not done:
- The 4K frame-time measure needs a 4K stepping harness. It is the one part of the task I did not meet, so frame time under 16.7 ms at 4K is unchecked.
- Hover focus ring.
- Backdrop drift.
- Cursor parallax.
- New-item glimmer.

TASK PARTIAL: the 4K frame-time measure, hover ring, backdrop drift, cursor parallax and glimmer remain.
